definitions.explanation: Multiple problems or issues considered collectively, often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}の{諸問題|しょもんだい}を{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
{社会|しゃかい}の{諸問題|しょもんだい}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
この{報告書|ほうこくしょ}は、{教育|きょういく}{現場|げんば}が{抱|かか}える{諸問題|しょもんだい}について{分析|ぶんせき}している。
examples.english: This report analyzes the various problems facing the educational field.

notes:
A compound of the prefix {諸|しょ} (various/many) and {問題|もんだい} (problem/issue). The prefix {諸|しょ} is a formal way to indicate plurality and is characteristic of written or academic Japanese. It appears in many similar compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸問題|しょもんだい}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to address various problems
- {諸問題|しょもんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}する: to solve various problems
- {諸問題|しょもんだい}を{抱|かか}える: to face various problems

OTHER {諸|しょ} COMPOUNDS:
- {諸国|しょこく}: various countries
- {諸事情|しょじじょう}: various circumstances
- {諸経費|しょけいひ}: miscellaneous expenses
- {諸説|しょせつ}: various theories
